title: projectDir
description: The service repository checkout the command runs in: the declaration, the fills, the generated output and the .stego folder with the record, the plan and the apply journal. Git keeps its history; every write goes through the apply journal.

title: registrySources
description: The one to eight registry folders the project resolves: the common registry checkout at its pinned commit, and any local registry. A run reads them and never writes them; the record pins their content by digest.

title: output
description: The new folder a build, download, image, verification or delivery check creates for its one result, named on the command line, with an exclusive create so a rerun never overwrites a result.

title: GITHUB_API_URL
description: GitHub's attestation store and Actions run history for the repository, read and written through its REST API with the job's token. GitHub runs it; the trusted signer attests into it.

title: inMemory
description: Values a command builds on each run from the files it reads and holds only while the stego process runs: every read model's table. Nothing is kept between runs.
